name: Decora S.A.
summary: Decora S.A. engages in the production, distribution, sale, and export of flooring products and accessories in Poland. The company offers vinyl flooring, underlays, skirting boards, and floor profiles. The company markets its products under the Arbiton, Afirmax, Vidella, and Ewifoam brands. Decora S.A. was founded in 1994 and is based in Sroda Wielkopolska, Poland.
